info.name: NGINX njs Scripting Connections Method POST API
NGINX Add a Server to an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of an upstream server group.

items.docs: Adds a new server to an HTTP upstream server group. Server parameters are specified in the JSON format.

info.name: NGINX Add a Key-Value Pair to the HTTP Keyval Zone

params.name: httpKeyvalZoneName
params.description: The name of an HTTP keyval shared memory zone.

items.docs: Adds a new key-value pair to the HTTP keyval shared memory [zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_keyval_module.html#keyval_zone). Several key-value pairs can be entered if the HTTP keyval shared memory zone is empty.
